codeReview.summary: Reviewed the feature entry, validation contract, worker handoff, transcript skeleton, shared-state files, and commit `d8c60aca51f7c910b89da5a24987eb21dddaff16`. The implementation satisfies the stated behavior: `services/auth-broker/src/config.ts` now exposes a deterministic test-only fallback injection hook, `services/auth-broker/tests/test-env.ts` resets that hook alongside the existing env-isolation helper, and `services/auth-broker/tests/config.test.ts` proves injected repo-root fallback dotenv values are used only when fallback is enabled and are ignored once `HACK_AUTH_BROKER_DISABLE_ROOT_ENV_FALLBACK=true` is set. This removes the prior dependence on ambient repo-root dotenv state. The feature has no direct `fulfills` assertions in `validation-contract.md`, and I did not find blocking or non-blocking code issues in the shipped change.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared env-hardening notes document the baseline auth-broker env-isolation helpers, but they do not yet mention the new deterministic root-fallback injection helper that this feature introduced for config regressions.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `.factory/library/environment.md:46-50` documents `installAuthBrokerEnvIsolation()` and `withIsolatedAuthBrokerEnv()` plus the disable flag, while `services/auth-broker/tests/test-env.ts:139-150` adds `withAuthBrokerRootEnvFallback()` and `services/auth-broker/src/config.ts:70-85` adds `configureRootEnvFallbackForTests()` for deterministic repo-root fallback contents.

summary: Pass. The feature delivers the intended deterministic auth-broker regression for the root-env fallback disable path and no code defects were found; the only follow-up observation is that the new fallback-injection helper is not yet reflected in shared library notes.
